name: UI：策略列表-表格列名验证
description: 验证策略列表表格包含7列：策略名称/策略阶段/环节/创建时间/更新时间/提交人/操作

steps.expression: return (() => { const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('th')).map(th => th.textContent.trim()).filter(h => h); const expected = ['策略名称','策略阶段','环节','创建时间','更新时间','提交人','操作']; const found = expected.filter(e => headers.some(h => h.includes(e))); return { headers: headers.slice(0,10), expected, found, coverage: found.length+'/'+expected.length }; })()

steps.description: 验证 验证表格列名 存在

steps.expression: return (() => { const ths = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('th, .ant-table-thead th')); return { columnCount: ths.length, headers: ths.slice(0, 15).map(th => (th.textContent || '').trim()) }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在相关数据
